An angle is a pair of [[half-line]]s originating from the same point.<ref>{{#cite:Q2305}}</ref>

[[File:Angle.png]]

== Notation ==

Angle $AOB$ is denoted by $\angle AOB$. Its measurement (noted $\alpha$ in the picture) is denoted by $\measuredangle AOB$.<ref>{{#cite:Q2305}}</ref>

== Formal definition ==

Let $A,O,B$ be arbitrary points in a [[metric space]].

$$
\angle AOB = [OA) \cup [OB)
$$

<ref>{{#cite:Q2305}}</ref>
== Measurement ==

The most common unit of measurement for angles used by mathematicians is [[radian]].

However, many different units of measurement exist for historical reasons:
